mapper.update: update sys_admin set password=#{password} where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select m.perms from sys_role_menu a left join sys_menu m on a.mid = m.id left join sys_admin_role ar on a.rid=ar.rid where ar.aid=#{id}

select a.*, o.name deptName, group_concat(r.name) roleNames from sys_admin a left join sys_admin_role ar on a.id = ar.aid left join sys_role r on r.id=ar.rid left join sys_org o on o.id=a.org_id where a.id=#{id} group by a.id
select password from sys_admin where id=#{id}
